body: BLOCK exact 3e959e6a269f571395d79f59c6ded4565043078f on two narrow source-contract mismatches. The corrected Estimate account is accurate, and the receipt plus no-admitted-ranking repairs are accepted. First, sections 5 and 11 freeze rank as channel-local, but candidates.scala:123-133 performs zipWithIndex inside the per-level flatMap, so semantic rank resets in every hierarchy stratum; lexical rank at :139-147 is channel-local. fuse at :63-68 then consumes n.rank without a stratum coordinate. A successor must name the ranking scope explicitly: preserve semantic rank as local to channel plus stratum and lexical rank under its declared scope, or openly specify a global rerank and its changed fusion semantics rather than calling that record-only. Bind the scope in fusion identity and add a mutation that collapses two stratum-local ranks into one asserted channel-global coordinate. Second, section 2.1 says a non-finite Observed sorts last. Scala DeprecatedDoubleOrdering implements TotalOrdering through java.lang.Double.compare: negative infinity sorts before finite values, while positive infinity and NaN sort after them. Keep the finite-before-sort refusal, but state only that non-finite values enter the declared ordering and can change take membership; do not generalize the NaN measurement to every non-finite value. One-document successor is sufficient; no other settled section is reopened.
